info.description:
## eCrop API based on **AgroConnect eCrop standard version 1.0.0** 

This API concerns registration of crop related activities like application of crop protection products and fertilizers and energy and water consumption.

This API is based on the Agroconnect eCrop class model

## Conformation
- [API Design Rules version 2.1.0](https://gitdocumentatie.logius.nl/publicatie/api/adr/) of the NL API Strategie (Dutch API Strategy)
- [IETF RFC 2119](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2119) Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels. S. Bradner. IETF. March 1997. Best Current Practice.
- [IETF RFC 3986](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3986) Uniform Resource Identifier (URI): Generic Syntax. T. Berners-Lee; R. Fielding; L. Masinter. IETF. January 2005. Internet Standard. 
- [IETF RFC 9110](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110) HTTP Semantics. R. Fielding; M. Nottingham; J. Reschke, IETF. June 2022. Standards Track. 
- [IETF RFC 8174](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8174) Ambiguity of Uppercase vs Lowercase in RFC 2119 Key Words. B. Leiba. IETF. May 2017. Best Current Practice. 
- [IETF RFC 6902](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6902): JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) Patch. P. Bryan; Nottingham, IETF. April 2013. Proposed Standard.
- [IETF RFC 9457](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457): Problem Details for HTTP APIs M. Nottingham; E. Wilde; S. Dalal. IETF. July 2023. Proposed Standard.
- [IETF Draft: Health Check Response Format for HTTP APIs](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-inadarei-api-health-check/) 
- ISO-3166 country codes
- ISO-8601 Date and time format
- [IETF RFC 9557](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9557): Date and Time on the Internet: Timestamps with Additional Information. U. Sharma;Igalia, S.L.; C. Bormann. IETF. July 2023. Proposed Standard.
- [SemVer](https://semver.org) Semantic Versioning 2.0.0. T. Preston-Werner. June 2013.
- [OpenAPI Specification](https://www.openapis.org/). Darrell Miller; Jason Harmon; Jeremy Whitlock; Marsh Gardiner; Mike Ralphson; Ron Ratovsky; Tony Tam; Uri Sarid. OpenAPI Initiative.


## Design decisions
- super/subtypes (UML generalisations): subtypes are allOf with $ref to supertype and subtype-object with subtype atributes
- UML compositions: hierachy in URI (should be aggegrations in eCrop class model) or array in master-object
- each **resource** which has operations defined on it, has a server side assiged identification named {**id**} (type idType (content+schemeId))
- each **schema** has a a list of client side assiged identifications named **{thirdPartyIds}** (array type with content+schemeId attributes)

## Default responses
GET on collection resource (with or without query parameters)
- 200: successful response returning list with 0 of more items. When no items are found an empty list is returned
- 400: bad request (f.i. malformed query parameters)
- 401: (token) authentication failed
- 500: internal server error

GET on singleton resource
- 200: successful response one item
- 400: bad request (f.i. malformed query parameters)
- 401: (token) authentication failed
- 404: resource indicated is not found (does not exist or client has no access to the resource)
- 500: internal server error

POST
- 202: resource accepted (asynchonously processed)
- 400: bad request (f.i. malformed payload)
- 401: (token) authentication failed
- 403: forbidden (f.i. when posting sub resources to a resource on which the client is not allowed to
- 500: internal server error

PUT
- 202: resource accepted (asynchonously processed)
- 400: bad request (f.i. malformed payload)
- 401: (token) authentication failed
- 403: forbidden (f.i. when posting sub resources to a resource on which the client is not allowed to
- 404: resource indicated is not found (does not exist or client has no access to the resource)
- 500: internal server error

DEL:
- 204: no content: resource successfully deleted (could also be 202 when processing asynchonously)
- 400: bad request (f.i. malformed payload)
- 401: (token) authentication failed
- 403: forbidden (f.i. when posting sub resources to a resource on which the client is not allowed to
- 404: resource indicated is not found (does not exist or client has no access to the resource)
- 500: internal server error

## Release Notes V1.0.0
Released for implementation of inbound-deliveries

## Release Notes V1.0.1
- Changed reference to eCrop class model in the *externalDocs* section to version 1.0.0
- Renamed schema *MeasurementType* to *MeasureType*
- Changed titles of Type schemas to correct English (separate words)
- Party Schema: typo: renamed property name *visitorsAdress* to *visitorsAddress*
- Party Schema: typo: renamed property name *emailAdress* scheme to *emailAddress*
- Grower Schema: fixed typo *visitorsAdress* and *emailAdress* in example
- Supplier Schema: fixed typo *visitorsAdress* and *emailAdress* in example
- ProductionLocationDetails Schema: fixed typos *visitorsAdress* and *emailAdress* in example
- PlantSpecies Schema: typo: renamed property name *plantSpecies* to *species*
- Tasks Schema: removed property *referenceId* (also in examples where applicable)
- Operations Schema: removed property *referenceId* (also in examples where applicable)
- Operations Schema: removed property *culturalPractice* (also in examples where applicable)
- Operations Schema: added missing property *type* 
- Operations Schema: renamed property *operationTechnique* to *technique* (q: which codelist?)
- AllocationDetails Schema: replaced *quantityAbsolute*  and *quantityRate* with *quantity* 
- AllocationDetails Schema: removed property *resourceId* (redundant with product-relation)
- CharacteristicsType Schema: modified definition of *characteristicsType* (separate value properties per type)
- Changed description of all *thirdPartyids* properties
- Added *additionalProperties: false* to pdt and udt schematypes
- Added reusable examples in the *components* section

tags.name: parties
tags.description:
**Operations on Party-level**

These operations are added to this API definition as an example of how basic party information can be exposed to external clients. This can be extended with functions for registering new parties (growers, suppliers) or letting them modify their basic information (name, address, contact info, etc.)

tags.name: delivery
tags.description:
**Inbound Delivery Operations**

These operations can be used for registering products which have been delivered to a grower by a supplier. Suppliers can only register deliveries for growers they are granted for, which they can check with the GET operations in this section (optional). Alternatively growers can register their inboud-deliveries themselves

tags.name: farm level registration
tags.description:
**Farm level registration Operations**

 Growers can use these operations to register non-crop related-) tasks and operations on **farm** level

tags.name: plot level registration
tags.description:
**Plot level registration Operations**

 Growers can use these operations to register non-crop related-) tasks and operations on **plot** level

tags.name: crop level registration
tags.description:
**Crop level registration Operations**

 Growers can use these operations to register **crop related** tasks and operations

This endpoint provides health status information about the API service, its dependencies, and overall operational condition. It is designed to be used by monitoring tools, load balancers, and orchestration systems to determine if the service is available and ready to process requests.

- Validator (function) app available?
- API datastore available?
- Servicebus available? 

**Usage:**   
- **Monitoring:** Used by system administrators and automated monitoring to ensure service availability.

ThirdPartyIdsType.description: List of alternative identifiers (\"AKA, also-know-as\") with which the resource is identified by third parties

content.description: Specific code from the code list that is referred to by listId.

listId.description:
Identifier of the scheme that contains the allowed codes.
The naming convention for the reference to a standard code list is: “nl.cl<nnn>” (e.g. “nl.cl232”).
Where "nl" stands for the 2 character country code, "cl" stands for code list and <nnn> stands for the 3 character Identifier of the specific code list within the scope of the specified country.

MeasureType.title: Measure Type
MeasureType.description: Standard data type for expressing a measurement with a value and unitcode. To be used for all types of measurements and quantities in this class model.

content.description: Expresses the measured value of the measurement.

unitcode.description:
The code that refers to the standard unit or dimension to express the value of this measurement. E.g. kg for kilogram.
listId: nl.agroconnect.codelists.cl020

CharacteristicType.title: Characteristic Type
CharacteristicType.description: Generic data type for linked characteristics to a crop, task, operation, allocation, etc.

code.description:
Content and listId of the code list that contains the coding of characteristics for a specific domain:

For instance:
The code list id for crop and operations characteristics for arable farming is nl.agrconnect.codelists.cl265.

issueDate.description: The data the characteristic was captured.

startDate.description: Begin date of the period this characteristic is or was valid.

endDate.description: End date of the period this characteristic is or was valid.

PlotType.title: Plot Type
PlotType.description: The type of production surface to grow plants. Can be a crop field for arable farming or a moving table (platform) for potted plants in floriculture.

ProcessStateType.title: Process State Type
ProcessStateType.description: Indication of the execution status of the task or operation in terms of: proposed, planned, executed. Code list: nl.clL256

ProductionSequenceType.title: Production Sequence Type
ProductionSequenceType.description: Indicates if and how the crop is combined with other crops. Enumeration: PRE_CROP = voorteelt, MAIN_CROP = hoofdteelt, FOLLOWUP_CROP = volgteelt, MIXED_CROP = mengteelt

ProblemDetails.title: Problem details
ProblemDetails.description:
Problem details based on the ["Problem Details for HTTP APIs" specification, RFC 9457](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9457).

Remark: According to Proposal NL API Design Rules 2.1 optional properties status, title and detail are required, type and instance are optional

status.description: The HTTP status code generated by the origin server for this occurrence of the problem.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type.

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem. It may or may not yield further information if dereferenced.

websiteUrl.description: Address of the website of the party

AssetDetails.title: Asset details
AssetDetails.description:
Details of the entity of a tangible object on which operations can be performed.
E.g.: a crop, a building, a machine, a ditch, a greenhouse, a climate control system, a feeding system, etc.

thirdPartyIds.description: List of alternative identifiers (\"AKA, also-know-as\") with which the asset is identified by third parties

startDate.description: The start data of the existence of the asset.

endDate.description: The end data of the existence of the asset.

Crop.title: Crop
Crop.description: The cultivation of a specific crop type (e.g. potato, wheat, rice,. etc.) on one or more plots during a specific period of time, specified by startDateTime and endDateTime.

CropDetails.title: Crop details
CropDetails.description: The details of the cultivation of a specific crop type (e.g. potato, wheat, rice,. etc.) on one or more plots during a specific period of time, specified by startDateTime and endDateTime.

year.description: Indication of the year in which the cultivation is harvested.

country.description: Country where crop is grown. Code list: ISO country code: 2 letter ISO-3166.

region.description: Region of a country the cultivation took place.\nFor eCrop in The Netherlands for this code list code list nl.cl044 is used.

useTitle.description: Code to indicate the type of legal ownership of the field that is used for the crop. For eCrop in The Netherlands code list nl.cl412 is used for this

productionType.description: Indicates the intensity of growing the crop. In The Netherlands used to report to the MLNV-RVO authority. Code list: nl.cl255

productionPurpose.description: Indicator of the produce purpose the crop. For instance: fresh marked, animal feed, seed production, etc. Code list: nl.cl251

regularOrOrganic.description: Production protocol: indicates whether this crop is classified as grown organic or non-organic. Code list: nl.cl015

netArea.description: The net (netto) area (in m2, hectare, etc.) of the surface that is used for growing the crop.

growEnvironment.description: Indicates in what type of environment the crop is grown; e.g. in the open air, in a greenhouse, etc. Code list: nl.cl299

growMedium.description: Indicates in what medium the crop is rooted; for instance in soil, in substrate, on bark, etc. Code list: nl.cl300

trackTillage.description:
Indicates whether the cultivation, over the years, is done in fixed lanes with fixed tracks for machinery.

true = track tillage is applied
false = track tillage is not applied

PlantSpecies.title: Plantspecies
PlantSpecies.description:
Crop type at the level of potato, sugar beet, onion, winter wheat, etc.
For mixed crops more then one type of crop can be grown in the same period at the same plot.

species.description: Code of the plant species, at the aggregation level of potato, sugar beet, onion, etc. For eCrop in The Netherlands, code list nl.cl263 is used for crop species.

variety.description: Identification of the variety of the type of crop that is grown. For eCrop in The Netherlands code list nl.cl232 is used.

precentageMix.description: To be used in case of a mixed crop. Indicator of the percentage of this crop species related to the other crop species that are part of this mixed crop. The percentage is based on the weight proportions of the seed of each of the species that are part of the mixed crop.

Plot.title: Plot
Plot.description:
Surface (area) that is used to grow plants.
The exact location of this surface is specified by either, a greenhouse-location a point location or a border location (using outer and inner polygons).

PlotDetails.title: Plot details
PlotDetails.description:
Details of the Surface (area) that is used to grow plants.
The exact location of this surface is specified by either, a greenhouse-location a point location or a border location (using outer and inner polygons).

area.description: The surface (measured in for instance square meters, hectare) of this production plot.

regularOrOrganic.description:
Indicates whether this plot is classified for organic production or not.
Production protocol: indicates whether this plot is classified  for organic production or not.
Code list: nl.cl015

localSoilType.description:
Code for the soil type, as used for a specific use case.
LocalSoilType code consists of the reference to the code list that is being used plus the code from this code list.
For eCrop in arable farming in The Netherlands, code list nl.cl405 is used

regulatorySoilType.description:
Code for the soil type, as subscribed by a regulatory authority (e.g. MLNV-RVO in the Netherlands).
For eCrop in The Netherlands code list nl.cl405 is used.

GreenhouseLocationDetails.title: Greenhouselocation details
GreenhouseLocationDetails.description: Structure with transparent walls and roof designed to regulate temperature and humidity for growing plants.

thirdPartyIds.description: List of alternative identifiers (\"AKA, also-know-as\") with which the greenhouse is identified by third parties

blockId.description: Identifier of a block (in Dutch: afdeling) within the greenhouse.

postId.description: Identifier of a post (in Dutch: paal) within the block of the greenhouse

upToPostId.description:
Identifier of a second post (in Dutch: paal) within the block of the greenhouse.
The upToPost can be used to refer to the location between two posts (postId and upToPostId).

waterTapId.description: Identifier of a watertap (in Dutch: waterpunt) within a greenhouse.

hortivationpointBlock.description: Coordinates of the standard Hortivation location reference point for the block

xyzReferenceToHotivationPoint.description: The xyz-position to the standard Hortivationpoint of this block within a greenhouse

Task.title: Task
Task.description:
A Task is the execution of one or more Operation's by a ma-machine-system.
A 'task' consists of one ore more 'operations' that are closely related but involve different assents and resources. All combined operations need to be carried out well coordinated, to execute the task.
For instance, the task potato harvesting involves: one tractor pulling the potato harvester, 2 units to take care of the transport of the harvested potatoes to the barn, equipment at the barn to unload the transport units and to bring the produce in the storing place.

TaskDetails.title: Task details
TaskDetails.description:
A Task is the execution of one or more Operation's by a ma-machine-system.
A 'task' consists of one ore more 'operations' that are closely related but involve different assents and resources. All combined operations need to be carried out well coordinated, to execute the task.
For instance, the task potato harvesting involves: one tractor pulling the potato harvester, 2 units to take care of the transport of the harvested potatoes to the barn, equipment at the barn to unload the transport units and to bring the produce in the storing place.

thirdPartyIds.description: List of alternative identifiers (\"AKA, also-know-as\") with which the task is identified by third parties.

startDateTime.description: The date/timestamp of beginning the execution of the task.

endDateTime.description: The date/timestamp of the ending of execution the task.

OperationDetails.title: Operation details
OperationDetails.description:
Activity carried out by man and/or machine as part op the execution of a task. An operation performs a particular OperationTechnique on a particular asset (a crop,a field, a production unit, a batch, etc.) to realize a certain Cultural Practice or Husbandry Practice.
Examples for CropProduction: The CulturalPractise "weed control"can be realized by one of various OperationTechniques like spraying, row cultivation, manual hoeing, etc.

thirdPartyIds.description: List of alternative identifiers (\"AKA, also-know-as\") with which the operation is identified by third parties.

startDateTime.description: The date/timestamp of beginning the execution of the operation.

endDateTime.description: The date/timestamp of the ending of execution the operation.

type.description: The type of operation. Code list Id for arable farming: nl.agroconnect.cl127

technique.description: Examples for Crop Production: The CulturalPractise \"weed control\"can be realized by one of various OperationTechniques like spraying, row cultivation, manual hoeing, etc. \r\nCode list Id for arable farming: nl.cl127 (or nl.cl293)

characteristics.description: The option to attach one or more characteristics about the execution of this operation.

area.description: The treated area (hectare, m2) during the execution of this operation. Can be a percentage of the total area or an absolute value (like hectare or square meter).

AllocationDetails.title: Allocation details
AllocationDetails.description: Details of the generic class (the parent) for input and output allocation.

thirdPartyIds.description: List of alternative identifiers (\"AKA, also-know-as\") with which the allocation is identified by third parties.

type.description:
Indicator for the type of input or output that is used or delivered by this operation. For instance: 
- "FERTIL" = fertilizer
- "PROTEC" = crop protection product
- "ENERG" = energy, etc. 
For this AgroConnect code list nl.cl271 is used.

quantity.description: Quantity of the allocation measured in absolute terms, meaning for instance applied liters or kilogram in total for this allocation (so not in liter/hectare of kilogram/hectare).

product.description: Product used as allocation in this operation

InputAllocationDetails.title: Inputallocation details
InputAllocationDetails.description:
One or more inputs used to execute this operation.
Examples of types of input are: crop protection products, fertilizer, water, energy, labor, etc.

OutputAllocationDetails.title: Outputallocation details
OutputAllocationDetails.description:
One or more outputs as the result of the execution of the operation.
For example harvested produce: potatoes, onions, flowers, vegetables, etc.
But an output could also be for instance energy.

TreatmentZoneDetails.title: Treatmentzone details
TreatmentZoneDetails.description: Part of the plot which is treated in an operation

thirdPartyIds.description: List of alternative identifiers (\"AKA, also-know-as\") with which the treatment zone is identified by third parties.

InboundDeliveryByGrower.title: Inbound Delivery
InboundDeliveryByGrower.description:
Materials and inputs delivered by a supplier to a grower as input for their crop process. An inbound
delivery describes a certain amount of a certain product acquired by a grower through an order to
a supplier.

InboundDeliveryBySupplier.title: Inbound Delivery
InboundDeliveryBySupplier.description:
Materials and inputs delivered by a supplier to a grower as input for their crop process. An inbound
delivery describes a certain amount of a certain product acquired by a grower through an order to
a supplier.

InboundDeliveryDetailsGrower.title: Inbound Delivery details as providerd by a grower (with supplier in the payloaddetails)
InboundDeliveryDetailsGrower.description:
Details of the materials and inputs delivered by a supplier to a grower as input for their crop process. An inbound
delivery describes a certain amount of a certain product acquired by a grower through an order to
a supplier.

InboundDeliveryDetails.title: Inbound Delivery details
InboundDeliveryDetails.description:
Details of materials and inputs delivered by a supplier to a grower as input for their crop process. An inbound
delivery describes a certain amount of a certain product acquired by a grower through an order to
a supplier.

thirdPartyIds.description: List of alternative identifiers (\"AKA, also-know-as\") with which the inbound delivery is identified by third parties.

dateOfDelivery.description: Date at which the product is delivered at the location of the grower (ISO-8601 standard date format "YYYY-MM-DD")

quantity.description: Quantity of the product delivered to the grower.

location.description: Identification of the production location of the grower at which the product is delivered

ProductDetails.title: Product details
ProductDetails.description: Details of a product delivered to a farmer, like any agricultural input, tool, or resource designed to support farming activities, such as seeds, fertilizers, animal feed or crop protection solutions.

thirdPartyIds.description: List of alternative identifiers (\"AKA, also-know-as\") with which the product is identified by third parties, e.g. GS1 GTIN, CGTB authorisation number, article code'
